lede: Wat Si Mongkhon (Kong) accounts for 49 catalogued manuscripts, 37 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Nan (98% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Tha Wang Pha District. Nearly all (98%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (80%) over palm-leaf · ใบลาน (20%). Dated witnesses run 1885–1960 CE (3 of 49 carry a date).

findings.title: The temples of practical magic
findings.gloss: 3 temples whose catalogued holdings lean unusually hard toward magic-ritual texts — well above the corpus norm.
